segments.sn22.11:1.4: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ rūpasmiṃ anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn22.11:1.6: paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.sn22.11:1.7: Vedanā anattā … saññā anattā … saṅkhārā anattā … viññāṇaṃ anattā atītānāgataṃ;
segments.sn22.11:1.12: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ viññāṇasmiṃ anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn22.11:1.14: paccuppannassa viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotī”ti.
